title: [Activity] Producing and Evaluating Content-Based Movie Recommendations

cues.en: So, open up Spyder if you haven't already.
cues.zh: 如果還沒開啟，先打開 Spyder。

cues.en: Let's open up the ContentBased folder in the course materials.
cues.zh: 開啟課程教材中的 ContentBased 資料夾。

cues.en: It contains a copy of the same framework that was developed in the previous section, so there's no need to go through that again.
cues.zh: 裡面包含上一節開發的相同框架副本，因此不需要再介紹一次。

cues.en: Instead, just open up the ContentRecs.py file, and the ContentKNNAlgorithm.py file.
cues.zh: 直接開啟 ContentRecs.py 與 ContentKNNAlgorithm.py。

cues.en: Let's start by looking at ContentRecs.py.
cues.zh: 先看 ContentRecs.py。

cues.en: This looks a lot like the RecsBakeoff file we wrote while testing out our recommendation evaluation framework.
cues.zh: 它很像測試推薦評估框架時寫的 RecsBakeOff 檔案。

cues.en: The only real difference is that instead of pitting the SVD algorithm against a random one, we're pitting a new ContentKNNAlgorithm against random recommendations.
cues.zh: 真正的差異只有，不再讓 SVD 與隨機演算法比較，而是讓新的 ContentKNNAlgorithm 與隨機推薦比較。

cues.en: Already, the work of writing that framework is paying off.
cues.zh: 先前撰寫框架的工作，已經開始發揮效益。

cues.en: In the interest of time, we're not going to compute top-N recommender metrics and only look at accuracy, but we will sample the top-N recommendations for user 85 just to get a feel as to what's going on.
cues.zh: 為了節省時間，不計算 Top-N 推薦指標，只看準確程度；但會抽看使用者 85 的 Top-N 推薦，了解發生什麼事。

cues.en: So what's in ContentKNNAlgorithm?
cues.zh: 那麼，ContentKNNAlgorithm 裡有什麼？

cues.en: Open it up and see.
cues.zh: 開啟看看。

cues.en: The main point architecturally is that we're creating ContentKNNAlgorithm as a derived class from surpriselib's AlgoBase class, here on line 15.
cues.zh: 架構上的重點是，第 15 行建立 ContentKNNAlgorithm，作為 SurpriseLib 的 AlgoBase 的衍生類別。

cues.en: If you recall, we can implement our own custom recommender algorithms by just implementing our own estimate function, and that's what we're doing here.
cues.zh: 記得，只要實作自己的 estimate 函數，就能建立自訂推薦演算法，這裡正是這麼做。

cues.en: But there's a bit of work we have to do before we can make those predictions.
cues.zh: 不過，在能做出預測之前，還有些工作。

cues.en: You can see that we initialize this class by passing in the value of K that we want to use in k-nearest-neighbors.
cues.zh: 可以看到，初始化類別時，傳入 k 最近鄰要使用的 k 值。

cues.en: By default it's 40.
cues.zh: 預設是 40。

cues.en: Finding the perfect value of K is just something you have to experiment with in practice.
cues.zh: 最佳 k 值，只能在實務中透過實驗尋找。

cues.en: Next we implement a fit function, which gets called by surpriselib when we train an algorithm.
cues.zh: 接著實作 fit 函數，SurpriseLib 訓練演算法時，會呼叫它。

cues.en: What we're doing here is building up a 2D array that serves as a lookup of the content-based similarity score between any two movies.
cues.zh: 這裡建立一個二維陣列，供查詢任意兩部電影的內容式相似度分數。

cues.en: This takes a while to run, so we print out our progress as we process every 100 movies.
cues.zh: 執行需要一些時間，因此每處理 100 部電影，就印出進度。

cues.en: The code here is fairly straightforward, you can see we translate user ID's and item ID's to their inner ID's, since that's what our predict function will be working with, and then we compute genre-based
cues.zh: 這裡的程式碼相當直接：將使用者 ID 與項目 ID 轉成內部 ID，因為 predict 函數會使用內部 ID；再為每一對可能的電影，計算類型

cues.en: and release-year-based similarity scores for every possible pair and multiply them together to generate a combined content-based similarity score.
cues.zh: 與上映年份的相似度，將兩者相乘，產生綜合的內容式相似度分數。

cues.en: There's a little bit of trickery that takes advantage of the symmetry of this 2D array of similarity scores.
cues.zh: 這裡用了一個小技巧，利用相似度二維陣列的對稱性。

cues.en: We know that the score between movies A and B is the same as between movies B and A, so we only compute that score once and copy it into both cases in the array.
cues.zh: 已知電影 A 與 B 的分數，和電影 B 與 A 相同，所以只算一次，再複製到陣列中兩個對應位置。

cues.en: Our fit function in turn relies on computeGenreSimilarity and computeYearSimilarity, which we've implemented here.
cues.zh: fit 函數又會呼叫這裡實作的 computeGenreSimilarity 與 computeYearSimilarity。

cues.en: We already reviewed this code in the slides, but again, the genre similarity is based on a cosine similarity metric between each movie, treating each movies' genre as coordinates in an 18-dimensional space
cues.zh: 投影片中已看過這段程式，再次說明，類型相似度是計算電影之間的餘弦相似度，把每部電影的類型視為 18 維空間中的座標，

cues.en: that represents all possible genres.
cues.zh: 代表所有可能類型。

cues.en: ComputeYearSimilarity is just using an exponential decay function to give more weight to movies that were released at around the same time.
cues.zh: computeYearSimilarity 則使用指數衰減函數，讓上映時間接近的電影得到較高權重。

cues.en: We'll come back to the mise en scene similarity function later.
cues.zh: 稍後再回來看場面調度相似度函數。

cues.en: We're not using it just yet.
cues.zh: 目前還沒使用它。

cues.en: Next we get to the main purpose of our recommender, the estimate function.
cues.zh: 接著，進入推薦系統的主要目的：estimate 函數。

cues.en: This is the same code we looked at earlier, and again, this is where the k-nearest-neighbors algorithm is happening.
cues.zh: 這就是先前看過的程式碼，k 最近鄰演算法發生在這裡。

cues.en: We select the k-nearest movies a user has rated to the one we're trying to make a prediction for, based on their genres and release years.
cues.zh: 根據類型與上映年份，從使用者評分過的電影中，選出與待預測電影最接近的 k 部。

cues.en: Then we just compute a weighted average based on their similarity scores and user ratings.
cues.zh: 接著，根據相似度分數與使用者評分，計算加權平均。

cues.en: So, let's see if it works!
cues.zh: 看看它是否有效。

cues.en: Go back to ContentRecs.py, and hit the play button to run it.
cues.zh: 回到 ContentRecs.py，按播放按鈕執行。

cues.en: Again, you'll want to go get a cup of coffee or something.
cues.zh: 同樣地，可以去喝杯咖啡之類的。

cues.en: It will take a few minutes to complete.
cues.zh: 需要幾分鐘才能完成。

cues.en: Hit pause if you're playing along, and resume when it's done.
cues.zh: 如果跟著操作，先暫停，完成後再繼續。

cues.en: So, you can see that we definitely outperformed random recommendations.
cues.zh: 可以看到，確實勝過隨機推薦。

cues.en: RMSE and MAE are both significantly lower than random recommendations were.
cues.zh: RMSE 與 MAE 都比隨機推薦明顯低。

cues.en: Scrolling down, we can compare the top 10 recommendations for user number 85 using both content based and random recommendations.
cues.zh: 向下捲動，比較內容式與隨機推薦，對使用者 85 產生的前十個推薦。

cues.en: Qualitatively it's a little hard to say which are better for this particular person, although we do know this user doesn't like movies aimed squarely at children, so Babe is probably a questionable result
cues.zh: 從品質角度，很難判斷哪個更適合這個人。不過，我們知道他不喜歡明確以兒童為對象的電影，所以《我不笨，所以我有話要說》可能是

cues.en: from the random recommender.
cues.zh: 隨機推薦中值得懷疑的結果。

cues.en: One thing that does stick out, however, is that our top predicted ratings for our content-based recommender are significantly lower than those from the random recommender.
cues.zh: 但有一件事很明顯：內容式推薦系統的最高預測評分，明顯低於隨機推薦。

cues.en: This is just an artifact of how we chose to compute those predictions.
cues.zh: 這只是我們選擇的預測計算方法造成的。

cues.en: For top N recommenders, it's the relative order of the predicted ratings that matters, not the predicted ratings themselves, so we shouldn't get too worked up over this.
cues.zh: 對 Top-N 推薦而言，重要的是預測評分的相對順序，而不是評分本身，所以不必太在意。

cues.en: But if you're really striving for rating prediction accuracy, there are ways of normalizing our predicted ratings to get them into the range we want.
cues.zh: 但如果真的追求評分預測準確程度，有些方法能將預測評分正規化到需要的範圍。

cues.en: You can look up log-quantile normalization, for example.
cues.zh: 例如，可以查查對數分位數正規化。

cues.en: But again, in the real world, nobody cares about rating predictions.
cues.zh: 但再次強調，在真實世界，沒人在乎評分預測。

cues.en: They care about your top N results.
cues.zh: 他們在乎的是 Top-N 結果。

cues.en: Still, from a purely qualitative and subjective viewpoint, these recommendations for our test user aren't that exciting.
cues.zh: 不過，純粹從品質與主觀觀點來看，對這位測試使用者的推薦，並沒有很令人興奮。

cues.en: Personally, I chose user 85 because his or her rating profile reflected some of my own tastes, and these recommendations aren't ones that I would feel compelled to act on.
cues.zh: 我自己選使用者 85，是因為他的評分輪廓，反映了我的部分品味；而這些推薦並不會讓我很想採取行動。

cues.en: Can we do better?
cues.zh: 能做得更好嗎？

cues.en: Let's see what other sorts of content-based information we might be able to roll into our content-based filtering recommender system.
cues.zh: 看看還能把哪些其他內容資訊，加入內容式過濾推薦系統。
